candidates.name: Python inherited bytecode suppression

evidence.claim: Environment suppression applies to interpreter imports and propagates to descendants.

risks: Direct invocations and explicit environment replacement need coverage.
candidates.decision_rationale: Wire the standard control into the generated dispatcher and direct hook paths.

candidates.name: Codex feature-gated memory startup

evidence.claim: Release startup checks MemoryTool but not generate_memories or use_memories.

risks: Running sessions keep prior config; desktop engine version remains unverified.
candidates.decision_rationale: Disable the feature and update helper, doctor and installer coherently.

candidates.name: Existing quick_cache 0.6.21

evidence.claim: Exact local pinned source confirms fallible async insertion and successful-value storage.

risks: Context7 docs are 0.6.18; live registry metadata could not be obtained.
candidates.decision_rationale: Retain dependency; fix application identity/accounting requirements.

maintenance.registry_lookup: Unavailable: TLS validation failure followed by HTTP 403; no freshness claim.

candidates.name: Storage-instance cache isolation

evidence.claim: Each storage owns a private cache alongside its fixed provider reference.

risks: A provider that changes internal remote model config would require a stable namespace.
candidates.decision_rationale: Reassess collision premise before widening provider identity APIs.

candidates.name: Bounded filesystem feeder leases

evidence.claim: Current optional mirror starts detached processes and has no concurrency limit.

risks: Stale leases, spawn failure, portability and skip-on-full semantics need specification.
candidates.decision_rationale: Use standard-library cross-process ownership rather than a new queue framework.

candidates.name: Full-pack mode-preserving copy

evidence.claim: Full distribution preserves file modes while mini copies only bytes.

risks: POSIX modes and Windows capabilities differ.
candidates.decision_rationale: Port existing executable intent handling and mode drift checks.

candidates.name: Verified installed-generation helper resolution

evidence.claim: Immutable generations contain helper payloads and are verified before activation.

risks: Missing or invalid generation must not produce a misleading repair command.
candidates.decision_rationale: Doctor should report a quoted absolute helper from a verified generation.

candidates.name: Single effective Codex-home resolver

evidence.claim: Projection, uninstall and verification currently derive target roots from HOME.

risks: Environment-only fix leaves skill copies under a different root.
candidates.decision_rationale: Apply one root consistently across all install lifecycle operations.

candidates.name: Materialized-output ownership contract

evidence.claim: Current assertion consumes roots from the same generator it compares.

risks: Avoid another redundant hand-maintained root list.
candidates.decision_rationale: Measure actual owned output and consumer classification instead.

candidates.name: Production-entry-point acceptance contract

evidence.claim: Authoring guide names native/OpenSpec artifacts but lacks an explicit integration acceptance template.

risks: Protected scenarios cannot be modified without canonical owner approval.
candidates.decision_rationale: Add a template naming entry points, collaborators, isolation and final gates.

candidates.name: Ignore bytecode in generation manifests

evidence.claim: Integrity verification checks manifested payloads rather than accepting runtime writes.

risks: Would falsely certify a mutated payload.
candidates.decision_rationale: Ignoring corruption would hide the defect and weaken immutable generation guarantees.

candidates.name: generate_memories=false as sole write control

evidence.claim: Generation flag changes new-thread eligibility, not startup consolidation authorization.

risks: Retained outputs, queued work and existing sessions can still write.
candidates.decision_rationale: Use the feature gate; use_memories=false alone is also not a write gate.

build_required.need: G1/G2/G7/G8: hook and Codex production wiring
build_required.why_no_candidate: Interpreter/configuration mechanisms exist; application dispatch, root resolution and diagnostic predicates require coherent edits.

build_required.need: G3: published pin rollout and load evidence
build_required.why_no_candidate: Release exists; operator-approved version edits, user merges and separately approved installation remain.

build_required.need: G4/G5: cache requirement disposition and accounting
build_required.why_no_candidate: Existing library fits; model mutability premise and failure/statistics contracts need application decisions.
No library can choose the repository-specific independent output/consumer contract.

build_required.need: G9/G10: bounded optional mirroring and scratch ownership
build_required.why_no_candidate: Standard primitives fit; capacity policy and real service isolation are repository responsibilities.
Repository ranking and output-count contract need a local algorithm correction.

build_required.need: G12/G13: mini baseline and executable modes
build_required.why_no_candidate: Reuse mode-copy pattern; derive current integration outcomes at the final boundary.
No external framework replaces the canonical entry-point acceptance policy.
